spec.title: vLLM: Token Throughput
spec.description: Number of tokens processed per second

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, engine, replica) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
sum by (model_name, engine, replica) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM: Finish Reason
spec.description: Number of finished requests by their finish reason: either an EOS token was generated or the max sequence length was reached.

spec.expr: sum by(finished_reason, model_name, engine) (increase(vllm:request_success_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
sum by(model_name, engine, replica) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM: Requests Prefill and Decode Time

spec.expr: sum by(model_name, engine, replica) (rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
sum by(model_name, engine, replica) (rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM: Max Generation Token in Sequence Group

spec.expr: sum by(model_name, engine, replica) (rate(vllm:request_max_num_generation_tokens_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM: Time Per Output Token Latency
spec.description: Time per output token latency.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

(sum by(model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_count{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: vLLM: Prefix Cache Hit Rate
spec.description: Percentage of prefix cache queries that resulted in a cache hit (GPU).

spec.title: vLLM: Cache Utilization
spec.description: Percentage of used cache blocks by vLLM.

spec.title: SpecDecoding: Accepted vs Drafted Throughput
spec.description: Speculative Decoding metrics showing draft and accepted token rates

spec.title: SpecDecoding: Draft Acceptance Rate
spec.description: Speculative Decoding acceptance rate percentage

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) * 100

spec.title: SpecDecoding: Accepted vs Drafted Tokens
spec.description: Total accepted and drafted tokens in speculative decoding

spec.title: SpecDecoding: Draft Acceptance Rate
spec.description: Speculative Decoding acceptance rate percentage

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) * 100

spec.title: SpecDecoding: Mean Acceptance Length
spec.description: Mean number of drafts per speculation

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: SpecDecoding: Mean Acceptance Length
spec.description: Mean number of drafts per speculation

spec.expr: sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])) / sum by (model_name, replica) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts_total{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM: Time To First Token Latency
spec.description: P50, P90, P95, and P99 TTFT latency.

spec.expr:
(sum by(model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, engine)(rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, engine)(rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, engine)(rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: vLLM: E2E Request Latency
spec.description: Latency from request start to first token returned (in seconds).

spec.expr:
sum by(model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
/
sum by(model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, engine) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval])))

spec.title: vLLM: Scheduler State
spec.description: Number of requests in RUNNING, WAITING, and SWAPPED state

spec.title: vLLM: Request Prompt Length
spec.description: Heatmap of request prompt length

spec.expr: sum by(le, model_name, engine, replica) (increase(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: vLLM: Request Generation Length
spec.description: Heatmap of request generation length

spec.expr: sum by(le, model_name, engine, replica) (increase(vllm:request_generation_tokens_bucket{model_name=~"$vllm_model_name", engine=~"$workerid", replica=~"$replica"}[$interval]))

spec.title: $trainer_metric
spec.description: Legend is project-experiment_name-metric name, with the last value on the right. The x axis is the training step. The query returns at most 100000 spans. A result that comes back full is truncated, and sorting cannot restore the missing steps.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "rl_insight_monitor" && span."monitor.trace_segment" = "metric_log" && span."metric.name" = "$trainer_metric" && span.project =~ "$project" && span.experiment_name =~ "$experiment_name" && span.global_step != nil && span."metric.value" != nil }
